caveats: adj_close is restated retroactively for dividends and splits, so adjusted levels are not strictly point-in-time; returns are standard practice but embed later corporate-action information
the endpoint is an undocumented public JSON API with no availability guarantee and no vendor support
prices are consolidated daily bars, not the venue-level quotes an execution model would eventually need
sessions after the original snapshot were appended from data/feeds (Yahoo chart API via the data-feeds workflow), adj_close rebased at the seam
license_note: public endpoint, personal research use; not redistributed as a data product

point_in_time.information_available_at: the close of the dated session
point_in_time.timestamp_semantics: bar timestamp is the session open; the date is the exchange session and the bar is complete only after that session's close
